content.outro: The roll lies open in the loft, and nobody falls in on the hall floor below.
content.premise: A hundred years ago the Harrowgate levy mustered in the hall under the hill and marched out, and none of them came home. They still fall in on the hall floor at dusk. The reeve who built the hall barred every way out of it so the dead could not leave: the loft stair, the cellar hatch, the stores stair, the grating over the cellar ladder. The bars lift when the muster falls. Somebody has to put it down, fetch the levy's roll out of the cellar, and lay it in the loft where the names are kept, so the levy can be stood down at last.
content.theme: A muster hall cut into a hill, where every way out stands barred until the dead levy on its floor is put down.
content.title: The Muster Loft
